name: The Center of the Universe
source:
When a freak storm – more than just a storm – forces Garrah to take cover, the world they emerge into is unlike their own: ours.

Unsure of where this new path will take them and limited to communicating with a rudimentary grasp of the few bits of language that connect them, the sisters Xochitl and Precious take them in, offering just a glimpse of a life slightly different from their own. Like two ships passing in the night. Two worlds touching from a distance.

[From [url=https://pixelsandpins.itch.io/the-center-of-the-universe]Itch.io[/url]]
